field_separator.description: Single-character separator between fields in the CSV (e.g., comma, semicolon, tab)

text_qualifier.description: Single-character used to quote fields containing separators or newlines

empty_fields.description: When true, preserve empty fields instead of collapsing them

verbose.description: Enable extra diagnostic output to stderr

columns.description: List of 1-based column indices to include in output; if empty, all columns are included

skip_lines.description: Number of leading lines to skip before processing
